integrity: Mathematical claims have self-review; finite experiments supplement a symbolic proof. No independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The natural density is bounded, not evaluated to arbitrary digits; method is specialized to the associated Pell sequence. Qualitative density existence, analogous Fibonacci sieve formulas, and local lifting tools predate this result. Overlap with unindexed computations remains possible.
title: Exact rank-stratified sieve and effective density bounds for coprime associated Pell indices
